verdict.rationale: Wise's card API documents granular per-card controls: toggling spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe) and creating rules that allow or block transactions by merchant category code or currency. The evidence does not show monetary spend limits per card, and these are Platform APIs for partners' customers rather than a documented finance-lead workflow for assigning controls to employees. Missing for 10: explicit per-card monetary spend limits, an employee-level card management interface for finance leads, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set per-card spend limits and granular controls for each employee

citations.quote: Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
